overall: The AG found the Board violated the Open Meeting Law by issuing insufficiently detailed April 8, 2013 minutes and by approving several sets of minutes untimely; it declined the broad and untimely allegations and ordered revised and missing minutes.

allegations.summary: April 8, 2013 minutes were alleged to be inaccurate and insufficient, omitting the subject of a resident's concerns and prior comments to the Board.
allegations.key_passage: However, the minutes do not identify the subject of Ms. Yuryan's concerns, namely, the Ashfield House.

allegations.summary: Minutes of several open meetings (July 2012, August 2012, January 2013, March 2013) were alleged not to have been drafted and approved in a timely manner.
allegations.key_passage: this does not excuse the fact that these open session meeting minutes were not approved until months, and in one case almost a year, after the meetings they record.

allegations.summary: The January 2, 2013 minutes were not timely approved; the Board's approval after the complaints was noted as not excusing the delay.
allegations.key_passage: while the Board also did not timely approve the January 2, 2013 meeting minutes, we find that those minutes did include a list of all documents and exhibits used by the Board during that meeting.

allegations.summary: Alleged that the January 2, 2013 minutes omitted a list of documents used at the meeting.
allegations.key_passage: we find that those minutes did include a list of all documents and exhibits used by the Board during that meeting.

allegations.summary: Alleged that the December 19, 2012 minutes did not list documents used at the meeting.
allegations.key_passage: We therefore find this allegation untimely and decline to review it.

allegations.summary: Alleged that for the past year the Board failed to accurately reflect tenants' housing issues in its minutes, a broad, generalized allegation.
allegations.key_passage: We decline to review this allegation because our office will not conduct broad audits of public bodies based on generalized allegations.

allegations.summary: Alleged that the November 7, 2012 meeting minutes were inaccurate or insufficient.
allegations.key_passage: we decline to review the specific allegation concerning the November 7, 2012 meeting minutes because it is untimely.

remedy: Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law, with a caution that future similar conduct may be considered evidence of intent to violate the Law.
Draft and approve revised minutes of the April 8, 2013 meeting, within thirty days of the letter.
Create and approve minutes from the August 22, 2012 meeting, if not already done, within thirty days of the letter.
remedy_passage: We order immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law, and caution that future similar conduct may be considered evidence of intent to violate the Law.
note: Read by a language model from the letter; every key passage is checked verbatim against it and dropped if not. A holding is the Attorney General’s reading of the law in this case only.
